$comment: Evidence map for Phase 43. Current evidence is inherited from Phase 29 integration contracts; universal interface registry and live connectivity remain declared.

areas.area: Protocol adapters and translation remain explicit
areas.requirement: Protocol adapters identify lossless/lossy translation and AI mapping proposals cannot silently change production mappings.

evidence.contains: AI never silently alters production mappings

areas.area: Interface traffic is authenticated, authorized and network constrained
areas.requirement: Webhook and network connectivity require signature, freshness, replay, authentication, authorization, TLS, certificate validation and allowlists.

evidence.contains: webhook delivery secure only with all checks

areas.area: Connectivity health, certificates, metrics and audit are observable
areas.requirement: Interface/provider health, sanitized logs, traces, metrics, alerts, certificate expiry and audit events are recorded.

areas.area: Connectivity changes, drift and unreliable networks remain governed
areas.requirement: High-risk exchanges require approval, schema drift responds by risk, critical connections can disconnect, and limited connectivity supports store-and-forward.

evidence.contains: high-risk integrations require full approval chain
evaluates schema drift response by risk

areas.area: Universal interface registry and live connectivity paths are wired
areas.requirement: Protocols, device/interface classes and access paths persist, resolve authorization and tenant context, and operate with live external connections.
